record.what_it_does: Grain is a meeting notes and recording platform that captures, transcribes, and organizes meeting recordings with AI-generated summaries, action items, and speaker insights.
record.auth_notes: Three authentication options: Personal Access Token (user-scoped), Workspace Access Token (workspace-scoped, admin-only), and OAuth2 Authorization Code flow with PKCE for third-party integrations.
record.access_notes: API access is not available on the Free plan. Personal Access Tokens are available on Starter plan and above. Workspace Access Tokens require Business or Enterprise plan with admin access.
record.main_blocker: Paid plan (Starter minimum) required for API access; no free tier.

evidence.quote: The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically.
Personal Access Token... Workspace Access Token... OAuth2 Flow... standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including the PKCE extension
OAuth2: the standard flow for building integrations to be used by any Grain user
Do I need a specific Grain plan to use the API? Yes... The Free plan does not include API access.
Recordings, Hooks, Users, Teams, Meeting Types endpoints with list, create, get, update, delete, download, upload operations

Webhooks let Grain push data to your system when events occur... recording_added, recording_updated, recording_deleted, highlight_added, highlight_updated, highlight_deleted, story_added, story_updated, story_deleted, upload_status
Grain's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server gives AI assistants direct access to your meetings, transcripts, AI notes, and workspace data.
Grain API reference and endpoint lists available at developers.grain.com (no OpenAPI/Swagger spec document published)
